answer:
Sea Limited reported cash and cash equivalents of **US$4,158,920 thousand (approximately US$4.16 billion)** as of December 31, 2025, per its consolidated balance sheet [Sea, FY2025, p.F-7]. 

Note that this is distinct from the combined "cash, cash equivalents and restricted cash" figure of US$6.4 billion (US$6,419,467 thousand) frequently cited in the MD&A, which also includes restricted cash of US$2,216,733 thousand [Sea, FY2025, p.107; p.141].
